The Court made the following ORDER:

Chittoor, filed the present Criminal Petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings so far as he is concerned.

sentences.text: 2. The above proceedings were initiated by the Food Safety Officer, Chittoor District, who was appointed under Section 37 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

The allegation m made ade in the said complaint was that on 27.07.2013 at about 11.40 A.M., he visited M/s. Sri Bhagyalakshmi Agencies situated at D.No.10-887, Seshapeeran Street, Chittoor for inspection.
At the time of inspection, A.1 was present and transacting business.
The complainant secured the presence of mediators.
On inspection, A.1 stated that stock of Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam sealed bottles 24 kept for sale for human consumption.

It is having the following label declaration :

sentences.text:
Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam Net 500 grams, M.R.P. Rs.No.99.00 Mfg. 29.06.13,
B.No.RAZB 3/09, Marketed by Hindustan Unilever Ltd.
Best before twelve months from packing Mfg by M/s.
Hindustan Unilever Ltd.
Plot No.AB/9, MIDC Malaganon Sinner Nasik Maharashtra - 4220103

On suspicion,
he purchased 4 sealed bottles each 500 grams by paying an amount of Rs.360/- to A.1 and obtained cash receipt, which was attested by the mediators.

He issued notice in Form V A to A.1 informing him that the above purchased Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam will be sent to the Food Analyst, State Food Laboratory, Hyderabad for the purpose of analysis and obtained acknowledgment on the office copy of the notice.

Thereafter,
he divided the above sample bottles into four equal parts and they placed in four separate clean, dry and empty sterile plastic containers and closed tightly with caps and tied with twine thread and sealed with sealing wax , and obtained signatures of A.1 and mediators and thereafter, he sent samples to the Food Analyst, who analyzed the sample and gave his report stating that "the sample does not conform to the Standard of Preservatives.
Therefore, it is Substandard".
Thereafter, as the complainant lifted the samples in sealed condition, he included the manufacturer also as 5th Accused.

The manufacturer - A.5 furnished the particulars of nominee,
who is shown as A.4.

As such, the complaint is filed against A.1 to A.5.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that so far as A.3, who is the petitioner herein is concerned, he has nothing to do with the manufacturing unit.
The company issued Form IX informing complainant stating that A.4 is the nominee of A.5 company.
He also filed a Memo dated 21.02.2024 before this Court furnishing Form IX - Nomination of persons by a company, which is mandatory under Rule 2.5.1 of the Food Safety and Standards Rules, 2011.
The same is placed on record.
So far as the petitioner herein / A.3 is concerned, he has nothing to do with the manufacturing unit.
In fact, A.4 filed an undertaking before the concerned Authority dated 10.10.2013 stating that he is the Manager of the factory situated at Hindustan Unilever Limited Factory at Rajpura, Punjab.
A.4 has also filed an affidavit stating that the sample was manufactured at Hindustan Unilever Limited Factory at Rajpura, Punjab.
He also confirms that he is the Manager of the said Factory.
As such, he is prepared to face trial before the trial Court.

4. Recording the aforesaid submission, as the petitioner / A.3 has nothing to do with the manufacturing factory at Rajpura, Punjab, the proceedings initiated against him is nothing but abuse of process of law.

5. In view of the above facts and circumstances, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated, in so far as A.3 is concerned, in S.T.C.No.258/2014 on the file of learned IV Judicial First Class Magistrate, Chittoor, are hereby quashed.
